newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ascom signs radio deal with Swiss army.
newsitem.headline: Ascom signs radio deal with Swiss army.

text.p: Ascom AG has signed a big contract to provide radios to the Swiss army over several years, it said in a statement.
The first tranche of the deal is worth 490 million Swiss francs, a company spokesman said, but he declined to say how much of that Ascom would see as revenue.

Ascom unit Ascom Systec is general contractor for the project. The radios were developed by Thomson-CSF and are being produced under license in Switzerland. "Companies from all parts of the country will take part," it said. The first radios will be delivered in 1998. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
